title: What's Your Server Doing?
description: A mod design for modpack developers. Make it possible to ensure that what's happening ingame and real-time.
body:
## What's Your Server Doing?
A simple mod design for modpack developers.
All the logs can be shown in chat.Make precise debug easier.
- In-game log output. Control with /consoleseeker <info|warn|error> <on|off>.
- Server friendly, players without operator permisson will never see the logs.
- Supports English and Simplified Chinese now.
